title: Separate an acquired nonlinear decoder from a finite original-state linear lift
statement: Set q=-div(f)/(n+1), T=f dot grad+q and acquire span{1,T1,...}. If it closes at dimension n+1 with phi=(1,psi), Tphi=Aphi, construct H and admit ONLY after H(psi(x))=x and psi(H(y))=y. Then x(t)=H(z_1/z_0,...), z=exp(tA)(1,psi(x0)), on the connected nonsingular interval. Constant nonzero Jacobian alone is not a global inverse. An exponential dimension separation from original-state-containing density lifts is not a lower bound against other classical symbolic recognition.
